title: atropis tenella
intro: Atropis tenella, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a plant species belonging to the Apiaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of A. tenella are attributed to its ability to alleviate fever, relieve pain, and promote respiratory health. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are found in its leaves, stems, and roots.
